purpose: Current bounded identity-level study-balance adjudications, not an irreversible blacklist or a change of scope.
supersession_rule: A later explicitly accepted source-backed adjudication may replace an entry. Preserve this exact prior entry and its evidence in a new durable audit before replacement, and record the superseding batch and rationale. No automatic override by stale enrichment or collector input.

decisions.title: Bootstrapping Informative Graph Augmentation via A Meta Learning Approach
decisions.reason: Substantial biological and molecular experiments are genuine, including dedicated OGB molecular-property results. Nevertheless, the main comparison, component ablation and sensitivity study deliberately give biological and social tasks co-primary evidential roles in cross-domain representation quality. The actual study does not establish biomedical primacy. This is not exclusion for a generic title/method, an absence of biomedical results, or a requirement for biomedical exclusivity or clinical validation.
decisions.reopen_condition: Reopen if primary documentation changes the interpretation of the principal experiments by establishing a biomedical-primary research purpose rather than co-primary cross-domain evaluation.

decisions.title: Completeness and Diversity in Depth-First Proof-Number Search with Applications to Retrosynthesis
decisions.reason: The actual application evaluates chemical-route feasibility, diversity and search completeness, without establishing biomedical or medicinal primacy of the principal study. Both the 40 public synthetic-accessibility benchmark molecules and the 20 Bayer-supplied drug-like molecules have drug-like provenance; no non-drug-versus-drug split is inferred. Provenance alone does not establish biomedical primacy. Computational retrosynthesis can qualify when its actual research is biomedical-primary; clinical or wet-lab validation is not required.
decisions.reopen_condition: Reopen if primary documentation ties the 2022 target selection and principal experiment to a medicinal discovery or other biomedical-primary objective. Do not import experiments from a later expanded paper.
